therapeutic_objective.statement: Evaluate a reproducibly characterized intranasal, cell-free regenerative product intended to support cognitive function and neuroregenerative biology.
therapeutic_objective.intended_strategy: Compare alternative product architectures for the same intended therapeutic strategy without assuming established efficacy.
therapeutic_objective.disclaimer: This objective is a development hypothesis, not evidence that SGL-001 is safe, effective, approved, or ready for human administration.
